Tom — thanks for the clear asks.

Quick summary / proposed approach:

- SOC 2 evidence cadence: We can provide a SOC 2 Type II report (current year) and scoped evidence for the following control families on request: CC2 (change mgmt), CC6 (access controls), CC7 (system operations). Typical turnaround for targeted evidence slices is 7-10 business days; full evidence packages (where applicable) are 15 business days. Retention: logs retained for 12 months by default; extended retention options available as an add-on.

- Pen test language: we prefer a 30-day notice window for scheduled penetration tests. We provide a dedicated staging environment (ephemeral) for pen tests; we do not provide privileged/root credentials to external testers. Scope should exclude third-party managed infra (cloud provider control plane) and any customer-managed integrations. We'll attach a short template clause and our pen-test ops template.

- Ops contact: Priyom Das, Security & Contracting (priyom.das@redwoodinference.com). For test-day coordination: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com), who runs assurance ops.

I've attached a redline draft (security-exhibit-redline-v2.docx) and an assertion map (SOC2-assertion-map.xlsx) to speed review.

If that works, we can produce a clean redline for your counsel to insert into the Order Form. Happy to hop on a 30-min call Thu/Fri if you prefer.

Best,
